comply-in.b: Engineering principle or commitment title (e.g., 'Explicit state, not hidden', 'Tool failures handled'). Max 4-5 words.
comply-in.span: Technical explanation of the guarantee or practice. Max 1-2 sentences.

p: Concise, authoritative explanation of the framework or core technology, its architecture (LCEL, LangGraph), capabilities, and ecosystem adoption. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

sec-head.eyebrow: Eyebrow label (e.g., 'The honest comparison'). Max 3 words.
sec-head.h2: Comparison heading (e.g., 'LangChain consultant vs LangChain agency').

tbody.th: Comparison dimension (e.g., 'Cost', 'Who builds it', 'Best for', 'Start time').
td: Assessment for Independent Consultant (direct access, speed, lower overhead).
Assessment for Development Agency (team overhead, management layer).

vs-agency.p: Contextual paragraph explaining when a direct senior developer is optimal vs when a full multi-disciplinary agency is required. Exactly 2 sentences.
